results.title: Absolute Batman #25: A Dark Turn that Touches on Parenthood and the Joker's Unfolded Empire
results.description: In Absolute Batman issue 25, writer Scott Snyder and artist Nick Dragotta recast the familiar Batman mythos, fusing new betrayals, a unified Joker-led criminal front, and an emotionally charged twist that places Bruce Wayne's personal life at center. The narrative explores how the surreal world shatters the superhero's sense of identity while also probing the implications of potentially fathering a child, an unprecedented angle that redefines the modern Batman saga.

results.title: The Birds: Sarah Snook To Lead New HBO Series Based On Alfred Hitchcock's Classic Chiller
results.description: A new serialized take on The Birds has been pecked up (sorry) by HBO, with Emmy Award-winning Succession star Sarah Snook on board to play the lead role...

results.title: Student-built haunted house returns at Elsie Allen High, public welcome
results.description: The production, a special showcase for the campus and its students, is now in its second year. This year’s theme is “Alien Invasion,” featuring UFOs, an enchanted forest and more.
